---
title: ""
page-layout: full
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
      .page-hero { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EEF2FF 0%,#F8FAFC 60%); padding:3.5rem 2rem 3rem; }
      .page-hero-inner { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; }
      .page-hero h1 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:0.5rem; }
      .page-hero p { color:#64748B; font-size:0.96rem; }
      .controls { max-width:900px; margin:2rem auto 0; padding:0 2rem; display:flex; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; }
      .search-mod { flex:1; min-width:200px; position:relative; }
      .search-mod input { width:100%; padding:0.65rem 1rem 0.65rem 2.6rem; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; font-size:0.88rem; background:#fff; outline:none; transition:border-color 0.2s; color:#0D1117; }
      .search-mod input:focus { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.1); }
      .search-mod i { position:absolute; left:1rem; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:#94A3B8; font-size:0.85rem; }
      .filter-chips { display:flex; gap:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .chip { padding:6px 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; background:#fff; color:#64748B; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; transition:all 0.2s; }
      .chip:hover { border-color:#6366F1; color:#6366F1; }
      .chip.active { background:#6366F1; color:#fff; border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); }
      .post-count-bar { max-width:900px; margin:1.2rem auto 0; padding:0 2rem; font-size:0.82rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:500; }
      .post-list { max-width:900px; margin:0.5rem auto 3rem; padding:0 2rem; }
      .pcard { display:flex; gap:1.5rem; padding:1.5rem; background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:16px; margin-bottom:1rem; transition:all 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
      .pcard:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.12); transform:translateY(-3px); }
      .pcard.hidden { display:none; }
      .pthumb { width:130px; height:100px; border-radius:12px; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.8rem; }
      .pbody { flex:1; }
      .pmeta { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.6rem; margin-bottom:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .pdate,.prt { font-size:0.78rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:500; }
      .prt::before { content:"·"; margin-right:0.5rem; }
      .pbody h2 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:0.4rem; line-height:1.4; }
      .pbody h2 a { text-decoration:none; color:#0D1117; }
      .pbody h2 a:hover { color:#6366F1; }
      .pbody p { font-size:0.86rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.65; }
      .read-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; margin-top:0.7rem; font-size:0.82rem; color:#6366F1; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:gap 0.2s; }
      .read-link:hover { gap:0.6rem; }
      @media(max-width:600px){.pcard{flex-direction:column;}.pthumb{width:100%;height:110px;}.controls{flex-direction:column;}.search-mod{min-width:100%;}}
    </style>

<script>
  let activeTag = 'all';
  function filterTag(btn, tag) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    activeTag = tag;
    applyFilters();
  }
  function applyFilters() {
    const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.pcard');
    let n = 0;
    cards.forEach(c => {
      const tm = activeTag === 'all' || c.dataset.tag === activeTag;
      const qm = !q || c.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (c.dataset.text||'').includes(q);
      c.classList.toggle('hidden', !(tm && qm));
      if (tm && qm) n++;
    });
    document.getElementById('postCount').textContent = n + ' bài viết';
  }
</script>
